title: Classic Beef Chili
description: A thick, hearty chili of ground beef, kidney beans, tomatoes and warm spices that tastes even better the next day.
equipment: Large Dutch oven or heavy pot

image.alt: A bowl of beef chili with cheddar, sour cream and green onion

steps.text: Heat the oil in the pot over medium-high heat. Brown the beef, breaking it up, until no pink remains and some bits are crusty, {time 8-10 min}. Spoon off excess fat, leaving about 2 tbsp.
Add the onion and bell pepper and cook until soft, {time 6 min}. Stir in the garlic, chili powder, cumin, oregano, paprika, salt and tomato paste and cook for {time 2 min}.
Add the tomatoes, beans and broth. Bring to a boil, then lower the heat, partly cover and simmer, stirring now and then, until thick and deeply flavored, {time 45 min}.
Taste and adjust the salt and chili powder. Serve with cheese, sour cream and anything else you like on chili.

notes: Chili keeps 4 days in the fridge and freezes for 3 months. It thickens overnight; add a splash of water when reheating.
